outputs.text:
GearSync

Imagine a sleek, modern logo featuring interlocking gears that form a stylized "S" in the center, symbolizing both Stanford and synergy among members. The gears are rendered in vibrant blue tones, representing trust and intelligence, with subtle hints of gold to denote prestige and innovation. The text "Stanford Engineering Club" is elegantly positioned below the gear design in a clean, sans-serif font.

GearSync

A bold, metallic gear is at the center of the logo, its teeth interlocked and pointing towards the four cardinal directions, symbolizing unity and direction. Surrounding the gear, the words "Stanford Engineering Club" arc elegantly in a sleek, modern font, complementing the gear's edgy design. The colors used are a gradient from deep navy to steel gray, reflecting both academic excellence and technological prowess.

Innovate Together

A sleek, metallic gear wheel overlaps a simplified, stylized letter "S" from Stanford in the center, with gears forming intricate patterns around the edges. The Stanford color palette of white and red is used to create a vibrant yet professional look, with subtle gradients that hint at depth and movement.

GearSync

A sleek, modern logo featuring interlocking gears forming a perfect circle. Inside the circle, the words "Stanford Engineering Club" are written in a high-tech, minimalistic font that contrasts yet complements the mechanical design. Above the circle, a small but eye-catching "SEC" acronym stands out, symbolizing strength and unity within the engineering community.

Innovate@Stanford

A sleek, metallic gear intertwined with the elegant leaves of Stanford University's tree logo, floating above a gradient from dark to light blue. The text "Innovate@Stanford" appears in a modern, bold font beneath, with "@Stanford" slightly smaller and lighter, positioned just under "Innovate."
